narrative.summary: Vanuatu has no AI-specific law or strategy yet. AI governance rests on the Data Protection and Privacy Act 2024, which gives a right not to be subject to solely automated decisions, and the Digital Transformation Act 2025, which gives the Department of Communications and Digital Transformation responsibility for national AI frameworks and oversight and creates a permit for AI and AI-related data services.
lead_institutions: Department of Communications and Digital Transformation (DCDT)
narrative.review_notes: This review was carried out on 13 October 2026 from Parliament's and the digital transformation department's websites, in English, French and Bislama. Not yet verified from the official text: material from the Reserve Bank, the Digital Transformation Masterplan (available behind a login), and whether a National AI Strategy is being prepared. The national AI strategy and a national security booklet on AI are tracked as leads.

instruments.official_title: Data Protection and Privacy Act No. 13 of 2024
instruments.english_title: Data Protection and Privacy Act No. 13 of 2024
instruments.summary: Vanuatu's first comprehensive data protection law, applying to personal-data processing by public and private data controllers and processors, with processing principles, lawful bases, rules for special categories and children's data, data-subject rights and cross-border transfer conditions. Section 13 gives data subjects the right, on request, not to be subject to a decision significantly affecting them based solely on automated processing, including profiling (defined as automated processing to assess personal aspects), with exceptions for decisions authorised by law, necessary for a contract or based on consent, in which case controllers must provide safeguards and the possibility of human intervention. It is enforced by the Deputy Commissioner of Data Protection and Privacy appointed under the Digital Safety Authority Act No. 15 of 2024, with search-warrant powers and offences.
instruments.current_status: In force: the Act prints 'Assent: 05/12/2024' and 'Commencement: 02/01/2025', and section 32 provides that it commences on the day it is published in the Gazette, taken as 2 January 2025. Regulator: Deputy Commissioner of Data Protection and Privacy under the Digital Safety Authority Act No. 15 of 2024.

instruments.issuing_authority: Parliament of the Republic of Vanuatu; assented to by the President of the Republic
instruments.publisher_name: Department of Communications and Digital Transformation (Prime Minister's Office)
instruments.summary: Act placing the Department of Communications and Digital Transformation on a statutory footing, with functions that expressly include developing and enforcing national ICT standards, data governance, cybersecurity and Artificial Intelligence (AI) frameworks (s. 3(h)), providing strategic oversight, coordination and guidance over all national ICT, digital transformation and AI initiatives in the public sector (s. 3(n)), and promoting research and responsible adoption of emerging technologies including AI (s. 3(o)); the Department reviews and approves government ICT project designs and procurements through a Certificate of Compliance. It establishes the National Digital Transformation Steering Committee and an ICT service permit regime under which businesses must apply to the Director for a permit, including a dedicated 'artificial intelligence (AI) and AI-related data services permit' class (s. 13(l)); AI and AI-related data services are listed as ICT services in s. 1.
instruments.current_status: In force: the Act prints 'Assent: 12/12/2025' and 'Commencement: 17/12/2025', and section 38 provides that it commences on the day it is published in the Gazette, taken as 17 December 2025. The bill was tabled in Parliament's Second Ordinary Session 2025, and a French version of the Act is linked on the Department's legislation page.

instruments.ai_governance_relevance: Statutory basis for national and public-sector AI frameworks and oversight (Department functions) and for licensing of AI service providers through an AI permit class.

coverage_audit.no_material_found_note: Vanuatu's Parliament bills pages, the digital transformation department, the Prime Minister's Office, the national CERT, ministries and regulators were searched. Apart from the Data Protection and Privacy Act 2024 and the Digital Transformation Act 2025, no qualifying AI-governance document was found; a national AI strategy and the national security council's AI booklet are listed as leads. The Official Gazette issues have not been read and the Digital Transformation Masterplan requires a login, so these and the Reserve Bank's AI material still need to be checked.
coverage_audit.technical_note:
Coverage note (original): Technical review notes: tier B/C batch run 2026-10-13, one agent, national level only (PROTOCOL §6), about 25-minute time box. Reserve Bank of Vanuatu TLS failure; ogcio.gov.vu proxy 502 (content moved to digital.gov.vu); gazette issues not read; Masterplan behind login. Publication dates taken from the commencement dates printed on each Act, which commence on Gazette publication (s. 32 of the 2024 Act, s. 38 of the 2025 Act). Harmful Digital Communications Act 2024, Digital Safety Authority Act 2024, Cybercrime Act 2021, National ICT Policy 2013, Cybersecurity Policy 2013, TRBR Broadcasting Code 2026: no AI. NSCS AI booklet undated (lead). Convention 108: not a party. Units covered: Law: Parliament bills pages (2024-2026 sessions) and DCDT/CERT legislation pages searched: Data Protection and Privacy Act 2024 (s. 13 automated decisions) and Digital Transformation Act 2025 (AI frameworks, AI permit) recorded; Harmful Digital Communications Act 2024, its 2025 amendment bill, Digital Safety Authority Act 2024 and Cybercrime Act 2021 checked, no AI provisions. No AI bill found.; Government: DCDT (ex-OGCIO) policies and strategies pages, PMO, CERT Vanuatu policies page searched: no national AI strategy or public-sector AI guideline published (strategy reported as in procurement; lead). National ICT Policy 2013 and National Cybersecurity Policy 2013 read: no AI content. Digital Transformation Masterplan behind login (lead).; Ministries: Ministry of Education and Training site, National Security Council Secretariat (AI awareness booklet, undated: lead); health, justice, finance, labour, interior: searched, nothing found.; Regulators: Digital Safety Authority / Deputy Commissioner of Data Protection: no AI guidance found. TRBR (telecom/broadcasting regulator) guidelines and Broadcasting Code of Practice 2026: no AI content. Reserve Bank of Vanuatu: site failed TLS verification, searched via web search, nothing AI-specific found. No competition authority or standards body AI documents found.. Not reached: Reserve Bank of Vanuatu website (rbv.gov.vu: TLS verification failure); ogcio.gov.vu (proxy CONNECT 502; content now on digital.gov.vu); Official Gazette issues (not read; publication dates taken from commencement clauses); Digital Transformation Masterplan full text (login required). Could not verify: Digital Transformation Masterplan AI content (download behind login); Reserve Bank of Vanuatu AI documents (site TLS failure); National AI Strategy procurement (news report only). strategy, ethics, risk-assurance, procurement, cyber-security, transparency, standards, sandbox, index-readiness, sectoral, generative-ai, drafts, international, historical: no material found.
